name: B10-0475/2025 (Renew) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a renewed partnership between the European Union and Africa, based on equality and shared interests. It asks for stronger cooperation on peace and security, trade and investment, climate and energy, and migration. It wants more support for young people, women and health, and a joint action plan for the next five years. It also urges faster ratification of the Samoa Agreement and more visible European engagement across Africa.

- The Parliament asks for a joint EU-Africa plan for 2025–2030; it is not yet agreed.
- It calls for more aid, investment and youth exchanges; African and European citizens would be affected.
- Leaders are asked to act at the Angola summit; no decisions are final yet.
